==Notes==
*Use as a [[cover]] enchantment to protect other vital enchantments from being stripped away and to benefit from enemy removal of this skill.
*Use with [[List of enchantment removal skills|skills that remove enchantments]], such as [[Contemplation of Purity]] or [[Release Enchantments]].
*If removed with a skill that deals damage, such as [[Shatter Enchantment]], the healing will occur before the damage.
